findings.detail: Kunyun is confirmed as a Beasts Pirates Number and was defeated in the Onigashima battle, but defeat alone does not establish whether she left the crew or whether its organization dissolved. Retain the unspecific affiliation and avoid inferring a negative or historical qualifier.

Linaria is captain of the Night Butterfly Pirates, an allied crew under the Red Hair banner, but the ontology lacks a dedicated allied-crew relation. The direct Red Hair Pirates membership edge was removed; no unsupported replacement predicate was created.

Leonero's Spade Pirates membership ended when the crew was integrated into the Whitebeard Pirates. The available evidence confirms his entry into Whitebeard's crew but does not establish when his membership ended; that relation is recorded with TimeUnspecified rather than guessed current or historical.
